publication: local commit only; no push or staging integration
package_inputs: src/planner (entire Python package and declared package-data)

native_dependencies.python: >=3.12; install pinned requirements on target architecture
native_dependencies.node: >=22 if bundled Claude CLI is installed via locked agent_backends package
native_dependencies.backend_executables: native installed Codex on PATH; Claude uses bundled managed executable or PLAN_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE override

control_contract.quiesce: panels executor quiesce --expected-incarnation UUID --expected-generation N --expected-revision FULL_SHA --expected-pid PID --exit-when-ready
control_contract.identity_fence: expected full identity/PID checked before admission changes and again after awaited drain
control_contract.successful_exit: committed controlled exit returns normal status 0
control_contract.resident_policy: KeepAlive={SuccessfulExit:false}; resident waits matching PID exit and refuses any replacement PID, never kills or bootouts a replacement
control_contract.rollback: failed candidate needs fresh candidate-specific health and quiescence; earlier exit receipt grants no authority over replacement

synthetic_evidence.mypy: Success: no issues found in 40 source files

gate: reviewed local source only; separate exact-head publication/integration clearance; no installed-session, physical launchd, account, reboot, network, or real-provider action proof

preflight.refusal: ValueError or OSError; no writes, lock, migration, or journal construction
preflight.authorization: compatibility observation only; fresh identity-bound quiescence remains required

vps_launcher.boundary: Supply explicit values after managed PLAN_* environment scrub; ambient values do not enable installed VPS endpoint.

answer_contract: permission choices and complete user_input maps share one durable VPS ask record, exact callback kind/child/turn/ID, immutable first choice, application acknowledgment, and reconnect reconciliation
held_content: canonical pending conversation content and original queued receipt commit atomically; original target/order restore; promotion/discard consume; interrupted dispatch retains bytes as uncertainty without native replay; no reconstruction of previously lost volatile content
